The game for 2 players is ideal for practising words and expanding vocabulary. The rules are simple. The first player thinks of a word for the second player to guess. On a piece of paper, they draw as many horizontal lines as there are letters in the word. The second player suggests a letter. If they guess correctly, the first player writes it on all the corresponding lines. But if the second player suggests a letter that is not in the word, the first player takes the head and hangs it on the gallows. The game continues in this way until the word is guessed or the hangman is complete. The first player wins if they have built the entire gallows. The second player wins if they have guessed the word.
